name: Shiraishi Saori
source:
A housewife waiting for her husband who is posted overseas. She is the epitome of a good wife and wise mother. She married her husband, who is one year older than her, through an arranged marriage.

She is slightly smaller than average in stature, but has breasts that protrude beautifully. She has not had sex since the birth of her daughter.

Although she has a mature body, she was brought up in a chaste family environment, and so she enjoys pleasuring herself alone when her daughter is out of the house or late at night.
